identityTest.stableIdentity: A learner admission and participation record remains identifiable independently of the scheduled delivery and survives delivery cancellation, postponement or replacement.
identityTest.versionIdentity: Transfer, waitlist, withdrawal or admission correction appends an attributable successor state.

references.purpose: Capacity, waitlist, attendance and delivery-completion masters; enrollment stores non-authoritative back-references only

invariants: Enrollment identity is external to delivery.
Login or access never proves attendance.
Cancellation of delivery does not erase enrollment.
Enrollment grants no qualification or credential.
A cancelled or superseded Enrollment remains historical participation and is not an active seat.
Attendance, completion and assessment are independent assertions.
Enrollment is not WM-ORG-016 assignment and grants no access.
Waitlist and transfer history never overwrite earlier states.
Every state append records actor and time.
Capacity and waitlist facts remain WM-ACT-038 Delivery-owned.
Transfer preserves predecessor Program Version pin and appends a successor state.
holds: Registry allocation is pending and no identifier may be guessed.
All base specifications and relation contracts remain provisional reviewable drafts.
Privacy, retention, source pins and executable conformance remain pending.
Package conversion and live verification are pending.
Frozen audit returned REVISE at revision 2; all 44 checklist items were remediated once without audit rerun.

digestPolicy.canonicalization: UTF-8 canonical JSON with sorted object keys and no insignificant whitespace
digestPolicy.coverage: all fields bearing on released semantics
digestPolicy.verification: asserted and unverified until live conformance closes

transferSemantics: Transfer appends a successor Enrollment version, retains the predecessor Program Version pin, and may allocate a successor Delivery without repinning the historical state.
